statement: Corporate income tax is a flat 17% of chargeable income for local and foreign companies, assessed by year of assessment (YA); under the tax exemption scheme for new start-up companies (Income Tax Act 1947 section 43), a qualifying company receives, for each of its first 3 consecutive YAs from YA 2020, 75% exemption on the first $100,000 of normal chargeable income and a further 50% exemption on the next $100,000, a maximum of $125,000 exempt per YA.
caveat: Qualifying conditions (Singapore incorporation and tax residence, shareholding limits) apply, investment-holding and property-development companies are excluded, and from the fourth YA the partial tax exemption takes over. Budget rebates move year to year (YA 2026 carries an enhanced 50% CIT rebate capped at $40,000); check the live page before relying.
